clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Singed Scale comes from the charred plates of electrified thunder lizards. Horde warriors bring the scales to prove their endurance and learn defensive combat.

Horde veterans judge a warrior by the blows they can bear while shielding allies. In Thunder Ridge, a canyon in western Durotar, lightning hides and thunder lizards crackle with storm energy. Hunting these beasts means enduring relentless electrical shocks and crushing blows. Their blackened scales show that a fighter can withstand punishing assaults and hold firm under pressure.

At the Far Watch Post, on the border between Durotar and the Barrens, the veteran warrior Uzzek asks initiates for five scales before teaching them. He believes they need physical toughness before they can learn stances and tactical defense. Bringing the scales proves they have the fortitude to join thick hide, heavy armor, and careful footwork into a firm defense against the Horde’s enemies.
